fix_commit_message:
Add NULL check

Reviewed-by: Saša Nedvědický <sashan@openssl.org>
Reviewed-by: Paul Yang <paulyang.inf@gmail.com>
Reviewed-by: Tomas Mraz <tomas@openssl.org>
Reviewed-by: Paul Dale <ppzgs1@gmail.com>
Reviewed-by: Neil Horman <nhorman@openssl.org>
(Merged from https://github.com/openssl/openssl/pull/28221)
agent_reasoning: Without the NULL check, printing an OSSL_HASH structure whose optional hashValue field was omitted (which is valid per the ASN1_OPT ASN.1 template) would dereference a NULL pointer in `hash->hashValue->data`/`length`, crashing any caller that prints such a certificate/CRL (e.g. `openssl crl -text`). Adding the `hash->hashValue == NULL` check before the dereference avoids the crash by making i2r_HASH() return an error in that case instead.
